posts.name: mlangsdorf
posts.cooked:
Ra, Argent Adept, Fanatic, and Scholar against the Ennead in the Tomb of Anubis.

I took some advice from the forum and played through it once outside the challenge to see if there were any surprises. Nothing too suprising (tank with Scholar and hope that Ra gets Drawn to the Flame early) so I went in.

My starting Ennead was Nuit, Set, Osiris, and Shu, I think. They pulled a first term Taste of Immortality for Atem and Isis and Nepythys showed up at some point.

It was a pretty straightforward damage fight with no particular twist. Ra eventually buffed up with Imbued Fire and his Staff and got the majority of extra plays from AA's Inspiring Supertonic. Never got out Drawn to the Flame so everyone had to be knocked out one at a time. Scholar used Don't Dismiss Anything a couple of times to keep Fanatic and AA in the fight and I did manage to get off a Verbal Sonata during AA's play after Set got incapacitated, which was pretty helpful.

So that's my sixth mint. How'd everyone else do?

posts.name: mightyschoop
posts.cooked:
Got the Mint cover. 

Concentrated on Nuit first because of the defense she gives everyone else. 

Never saw Flesh of the Sun God, but debated on playing Flame Barrier vs. Imbued Fire. Should have gone with Barrier that turn, because Imbued Fire works both ways and Ra went down hard to an elemental storm and its after-effects (getting pounded by Nephthys and Set) the next turn. 

I left Nomti out for a couple turns because he was pounding bad guys, but when he dropped below 4 hp, he was Final Dive fodder. 

I had to go into heal-zap shenanigans between AA and Scholar to stay alive. "Get out of the way" is so much fun when there are a lot of targets out there. 

Last turn, I had AA (5 hp) and Scholar (15) still up, Set was at 5 hp, Isis at ~18. Challenge of Fire and Swinging blades were in play in the environment. Shu pulls out a Judgment of Anubis during the villain turn. I determined Scholar could survive the upcoming environment turn, and I could win if I got Isis down below 8 hp. There was much heal-zapping, and the Tomb pulled out the win for me. Scholar left standing at 15 hp, everyone else incapped. 

Good setup this week. I like playing against the Ennead.

posts.name: schadkehnfreude
posts.cooked:
Hm - I musta gotten a really optimal setup because I minted this one and it wasn't particularly close.

Ra was unsurprisingly the MVP.  Dropped Flame Barrier turn 1, dropped Flesh of the Sun God turn 2 and it was all downhill sledding from there.  Imbued Fire was adding insult to injury, and Argent Adept getting Inspiring Presence to allow Ra to put up the fire damage shield AND nuke was gravy.  Scholar opened with two Grace Under Fires which are at their best early on vs. Ennead.  Nuit didn't survive past turn 2.  Once Challenge of Fire popped it got downright comical - my team LOL'd while the Ennead ate 4 fire damage per turn.

The only time it got kind of hairy was when dead Set played Fanatic's Divine Sacrifice and the incoming damage took her down to 4, but I had an Aegis.  Also, use the Staff power early and often so Ra can keep playing new ones for the HP bump - he will take a lot of damage.

I can see where this would've been a challenge 95% of the time but I got a god hand, pardon the pun.  Between Flesh of the Sun God and Challenge of the Flame, my guys skunked the Ennead so badly that I coulda mummified their remains with a box of kid's Band-Aids
